name: Venomancer: Web Wrap wraps the target in a cocoon instead of a pig
contract: Spell.dbc 504335 Web Wrap (server and client DBC agree) applies SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN and SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM with MiscValue 411372 for 5 seconds and requires caster aura 800841 Spider Form. Its tooltip reads 'Wrap your target in a cocoon, stunning them for 5 sec.' The client's CreatureDisplayInfo 411372 uses model 411372 creature\cocoon\cocoon.m2. Without creature template 411372 the engine falls back to pig display 16358. A Web Wrap cast from Spider Form on a hostile dummy must stun it, give it display 411372 while the aura lasts, and restore its original display when the aura expires. The scenario proves the server display selection, not client rendering.

steps.label: Clear the GCD from entering Spider Form
Web Wrap is on the target
DISCRIMINATING: the target wears the cocoon display, not the pig
The wrap lasts the tooltip's 5 seconds
The target returns to its own display
